title: IngestBatch
description: The body POSTed to /telemetry/ingest. Three producers build it by hand in three languages and telemetry walks it as raw JSON, so no compiler sees this shape. Field types mirror telemetry's FieldKind exactly: NonEmptyString, Finite (any JSON number) and NonNegativeInt (a number with no fractional part, which is what JSON Schema calls an integer).

readings.description: One tick, all-or-nothing. The cap is telemetry's MAX_BATCH_READINGS; ap-collector chunks to the same number.

not.$comment: The batch owns buildingId. Telemetry stamps it onto every reading and rejects one that names a different building, so a reading carrying it can only agree or break.

type.$comment: The registry dispatches on this. An unknown value rejects the whole batch.

reading.$comment: Extra keys are allowed: a plugin's own fields ride along and are flattened into the published reading.

then.$comment: The one metric whose value field is not its own name: telemetry reads indoor_aqi, but only pm25 and co2 are required, so a reading without indoor_aqi is stored as zero rather than refused.
